modal: This page shows all of the groups and subgroups in your project. The first group has been created for you. To create a subgroup for it, click the "New group" button and follow the prompts in the inspector on the right side of the screen.

headers.title: Pseudonym Group Management
headers.subtitle: Manage pseudonym groups, their hierarchy, and group-specific configuration.

default.text: Select an entity or a group to see its settings here.

inputs.psnexampleNew: The pseudonym will look like this:

alphabet.label: Alphabet
alphabet.help: Select an alphabet for the pseudonyms.
alphabet.fixedAlgorithmError: This algorithm requires its predefined alphabet; changing the alphabet is not possible.

customAlphabetChars.label: Custom alphabet characters
customAlphabetChars.help: Enter every character that may appear in generated pseudonyms. This is a literal character list, not a regular expression.

maxnumpsn.label: Max. number of pseudonyms
maxnumpsn.help: Estimated upper bound for the maximum number of pseudonyms needed in this group. This value is used to calculate an optimal pseudonym length.

multiplepsn.label: Allow multiple pseudonyms for the same value?

validityTime.label: Validity period
validityTime.help: Optional validity period used to calculate the end date when no explicit end date is entered. Examples: 3days, 1 day, 50 day, 7w, or 5 y. Supported units include years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, and nanoseconds. If an end date is provided, the validity period is ignored.

randomAlgorithmDesiredSuccessProbability.label: Desired success probability
randomAlgorithmDesiredSuccessProbability.help: Target probability that a random pseudonym can be generated without collision. Use a value between 0 and 1, for example 0.99999998.

consecutiveValueCounter.label: Consecutive numbering counter
consecutiveValueCounter.help: Starting counter used only when the consecutive-number algorithm is selected. Other algorithms internally use 1.

saltLength.label: Salt length
saltLength.help: The default is 32. Increase this only when you need a longer generated salt.

salt.label: Salt
salt.help: Optional explicit salt used for pseudonym generation. Leave empty so the backend can generate or use its default salt handling.

inputs.inheritedEditable: Inherited from parent group; you can override it.

messages.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Would you like to save before continuing?
